question:
What is the meaning of hazardous
substances in relation to material inputs?
description: Hazardous substances in relation to material inputs refer to substances that can have a negative impact on human health or the environment, either immediately or over time, either on their own or through interactions with other factors. These substances are typically identified by international or national regulations that provide guidance on their proper handling and disposal.
